questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The work done by the centripetal force on a body moving in a circle at constant speed in one full revolution is:
questions.explanation: The centripetal force is always perpendicular to the displacement, so W = F s cos 90° = 0 at every instant.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 5: Work, Energy and Power

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The apparent change in the frequency of sound when the source and the listener move relative to each other is called the:
questions.explanation: An approaching source raises the apparent frequency and a receding one lowers it, which is why the horn of a passing train sounds shriller and then deeper.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A cell of emf E and internal resistance r is connected across an external resistance R. The terminal potential difference is:
questions.explanation: Some emf is used up inside the cell, so V = E - Ir. The terminal voltage equals the emf only when no current is drawn.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Heisenberg's uncertainty principle states that it is impossible to determine simultaneously and exactly the:
options: Mass and charge of an electron
Position and momentum of an electron
Spin and charge of an electron
Energy and mass of an electron
questions.explanation: Δx × Δp is at least h/4π, which is why Bohr's definite orbits give way to orbitals, that is regions of probability.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The solubility of silver chloride in water decreases when sodium chloride is added to it. This is due to the:
options: Increase in ionic product of water
questions.explanation: Added Cl⁻ pushes the equilibrium AgCl ⇌ Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ backwards so that the solubility product Ksp is not exceeded, and AgCl precipitates out.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The correct order of reactivity of alkyl halides towards an SN2 reaction is:
questions.explanation: SN2 happens in a single step through a crowded transition state, so the least hindered methyl halide reacts fastest. This order is exactly opposite to SN1.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 6: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: A lichen is best described as a symbiotic association between:
options: A fungus and the roots of a higher plant
questions.explanation: The alga, called the phycobiont, makes food while the fungus, the mycobiont, absorbs water and minerals and shelters it. Lichens are sensitive pollution indicators.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a different plant of the same species is called:
questions.explanation: Xenogamy is the only type that brings genetically different pollen to the stigma, so it alone produces real genetic variation.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 1: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The QRS complex of a normal electrocardiogram represents:
questions.explanation: The P wave is atrial depolarisation, QRS is ventricular depolarisation that begins ventricular contraction, and the T wave is ventricular repolarisation.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 15: Body Fluids and Circulation

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The experiment of Stanley Miller and Harold Urey supported the theory of:
questions.explanation: Passing electric discharge through methane, ammonia, hydrogen and water vapour produced amino acids, showing that organic monomers could form in primitive conditions.
